no_access.title: You cannot open this page
no_access.description: Your console role does not allow this page. Ask a super admin for access if you need it.

home.description: Where the platform team provisions accounts and watches the platform.
home.none: Your role opens no area of the console yet.

areas.accounts: Provision merchant accounts, act on one with a support reason, suspend or close it.
areas.rollout: Choose who gets each module: no one, the allowlisted accounts, or every account.

consumers.title: Outbox consumers
consumers.description: Parked and dead events per consumer, and how far each one is behind.
consumers.failed: The consumers could not be read. Reload the page to try again.

authz.not_permitted: Your console role does not allow this.

accounts.description: Every merchant account on the platform. Open one to act on it with a support reason.
accounts.empty_hint: Provision the first merchant account to start.
accounts.empty_filtered_hint: Try again by editing the filters.

provision.title: Provision an account
provision.description: The account starts as provisioned and turns active when its owner accepts the invitation.

sections.limits_hint: Every limit is required; 0 allows none. You can raise them later.
sections.modules_hint: The modules this account gets from the start. Each still follows its rollout mode.
sections.owner_hint: We email the owner an invitation. The account becomes active when they accept it.

fields.name: Account name
fields.name_hint: 1 to 80 characters on one line, no web address.

limits.orders_per_month_hint: New orders the account may create in a calendar month.
limits.drivers_hint: Drivers the account may have at once.
limits.sites_hint: Branches and warehouses the account may have.
limits.api_keys_hint: Keys for the merchant's own integrations.

provision.invited_notice: Account provisioned. The owner's invitation went to {email}.

account.failed: The account could not be loaded.

gate.title: Why are you opening {name}?
gate.description: Every read of this account's data is recorded with this reason in the audit log. It stays with this tab until you exit the account.
gate.label: Support reason

notice.suspended_hint: Its staff cannot sign in and its outgoing messages are held until it is reactivated.
notice.closed_hint: Closing is permanent. Its data is kept and stays readable here.

details.title: Details
details.description: Name, language and limits. Lowering a limit below what is used only blocks new ones.
details.read_only: Only a platform admin with the provisioning permission changes these.

invite.title: Invite an owner
invite.description: We email an invitation. An account may have more than one owner.
invite.already_active: This person is already an active owner of the account.

lifecycle.title: Account status
lifecycle.description: Suspend stops the account for now; close ends it for good.

consequences.a: Its staff are signed out and cannot sign in or refresh a session.
consequences.b: Its outgoing messages and integrations are held.
consequences.c: Its data is kept. You can reactivate it later.

consequences.a: Its staff can sign in again.

close.title: Close {name} for good?

consequences.a: Closing is permanent: the account cannot be reopened from the console.
consequences.b: Every session ends and open invitations stop working.
consequences.c: Its data is kept as the retention rules require.

close.type_name: Type the account name to confirm

not_allowed.suspend: Only an active account can be suspended.
not_allowed.reactivate: Only a suspended account can be reactivated.
not_allowed.close: Only a suspended or provisioned account can be closed.

lifecycle.conflict: The account changed in the meantime. The page now shows its current status.

flags.title: Modules
flags.description: Turn a module on or off for this account. Each change needs a reason and is recorded.
flags.delay_notice: A change can take up to a minute to reach the account.

effect.all: On for every account: the rollout mode is all.
effect.off: Off for every account: the rollout mode is off.
effect.on_here: On for this account: it is on the allowlist.
effect.off_here: Off for this account: it is not on the allowlist.

dialog.description: The reason is recorded with the change in the audit log.

flags.done: Saved. A change can take up to a minute to reach the account.

rollout.description: Who gets each module. Only a super admin changes a mode; each change needs a reason.

meaning.off: No account gets this module, whatever its own setting.
meaning.allowlist: Only the accounts where it is turned on get this module.

rollout.never_changed: Never changed: the default is allowlist.
rollout.done: Saved. A change can take up to a minute to apply.
